Risk Title & Description: Automated Bot Spam on Checkout and Reviews Endpoints
Mitigation Implemented: Implemented hidden honeypots (companyUrl), 1.2s rapid submission checks, 15-30s session rate limiting, and script tag stripping (<>) across CheckoutPage.jsx and Reviews.jsx.

Risk Title & Description: Administrative Authorization Reliant on Document Reads
Mitigation Implemented: Updated firestore.rules to support Firebase Auth Custom Claims (request.auth.token.admin == true) directly; added explicit gallery_photos rules and bounded review validations.

Risk Title & Description: Transactional Email Delivery Resilience & Network Glitches
Mitigation Implemented: Added automatic 1.5s retry mechanism with exponential backoff and 10s AbortController in emailService.js, preserving non-blocking database writes.
Updated baseline-browser-mapping to latest version; eliminated all console warnings during test execution and production build.

Risk Title & Description: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) on Catalog Images
Mitigation Implemented: Enforced explicit width/height dimensions (400x320/384), loading='lazy', decoding='async', and object-cover across all 5 catalog views (Gallery, Seasonal, Cupcakes, Cookies, Catering).

Risk Title & Description: Draft Persistence and Network Interruption During Checkout
Mitigation Implemented: Implemented automatic session draft preservation in CheckoutPage.jsx, navigator.onLine detection, and automatic draft clearing upon successful order placement.

Risk Title & Description: Search Engine Crawler Discovery and Freshness Metadata
Mitigation Implemented: Updated public/sitemap.xml with explicit <lastmod>2026-11-11</lastmod> timestamps for all canonical routes and added /track-order.

Risk Title & Description: Client-Side Error Logging and Diagnostic Capture
Mitigation Implemented: Enhanced GlobalErrorBoundary in App.js with structured error telemetry (timestamp, stack, component, URL, user agent), window.__GET_APP_TELEMETRY__(), and 1-click diagnostic copy button.
